Act7-1#1.t: My husband... thank heaven you're safe...

Act7-1#2.zh: 高俅虽败，仍借白虎节堂一事定我罪，判我刺配沧州。娘子，这一去不知几时才能回来……
Act7-1#2.t: Gao Qiu was beaten, but he still used the White Tiger Hall affair to convict me. I'm sentenced to exile in Cangzhou. My dear, I don't know when I'll be back...

Act7-1#3.zh: 相公蒙冤受屈，小女子怎会因而埋怨？我在东京等你回来！
Act7-1#3.t: You've been wronged, husband. How could I blame you? I'll wait for you in Kaifeng!

Act7-1#4.zh: 这一路凶险，不能带你同行；等我在沧州安顿下来，再设法接你过去。
Act7-1#4.t: The road is dangerous; I can't take you with me. Once I'm settled in Cangzhou, I'll find a way to bring you there.

Act7-1#5.zh: 相公保重，我和锦儿在东京等你。
Act7-1#5.t: Take care, husband. Jin'er and I will wait for you in Kaifeng.

Act7-1#6.zh: 锦儿，你照顾好夫人；此去沧州，我会小心。等我离开后，你们寻处安身，莫要叫高府的人找到。
Act7-1#6.t: Jin'er, look after your mistress. I'll be careful on the way to Cangzhou. Once I'm gone, find somewhere safe to stay, and don't let anyone from the Gao manor find you.

Act7-1#7.zh: 是的！老爷，行李都打包完成；马车也在外头等着。
Act7-1#7.t: Yes, master! The baggage is all packed, and the carriage is waiting outside.

Act7-1#8.zh: 董超、薛霸二位公人也已到门外？林冲这便随二位起程。
Act7-1#8.t: Are the two guards, Dong Chao and Xue Ba, at the door too? Then I'll set out with them.

Act7-1#9.zh: 那位%X大爷在出门前就吩咐小女子打包行李了...
Act7-1#9.t: Master %X told me to pack before he went out...

Act7-1#11.zh: 娘子珍重。董超、薛霸两位公人押我去沧州，诸位不必明着相送。
Act7-1#11.t: Take care, my dear. Dong Chao and Xue Ba are escorting me to Cangzhou. There's no need for anyone to see me off openly.

Act7-1#12.zh: 二位公人这就押林教头起程。我们不能明着同行，待他们走远，便暗中跟上，护他一路去沧州。
Act7-1#12.t: The two guards will take Instructor Lin now. We can't travel with them openly. Once they're some way off, we'll follow in secret and protect him all the way to Cangzhou.

Act7-1#13.zh: 董超、薛霸押着林冲离去。众人忧心忡忡，悄悄出城，远远跟上。
Act7-1#13.t: Dong Chao and Xue Ba lead Lin Chong away. Worried, the others slip out of the city and follow at a distance.
